headline: A clear cost driver emerged in this window

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The size‑up after a loss cost ₹1,05,732. It happened in 96 trades, where the median entry size after a loss was ₹12,562 compared with a usual median of ₹6,578, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a win rate of 28%, versus a 39% win rate on other trades.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is something to keep an eye on.

closing: For the next window, try following the rule to keep your entry size consistent after a loss.
